comparisonScope: Focused, tick-frozen rendering-isolation measurements; not a normal-game overall FPS claim.

baseline.notes: Saved baseline renderer bytecode was verified against a direct compilation of 0c1ba0b. Snapshot adds only low-frequency yaw/age invalidation hooks, with no renderer hot-path change.

candidate.implementation: Single-pass collect with per-entity eligibility/fire cache keyed by tickCount, ItemStack identity and component version; correctness invalidation repairs.

method.items: 10000 netherite sword entities on the ground; normal gravity/collision flags, no item-tick cancellation mixin.
method.freezePurpose: Exclude normal entity-tick cost to isolate scene rebuilds. Product code has no freeze-specific fast path.
method.capture: One continuous focused 20-second sample per variant/mode. Unfocused samples are discarded and restarted. Frame data is buffered until capture completion.

modes.forced: Mark sceneDirty each rendered frame, force complete scene rebuild.
modes.edge: Yaw=45*sin(elapsedSeconds), updated on client ticks; visible count ranges 7838..10000.

metrics.low1PercentFps: 1e9 / arithmetic mean of the slowest ceil(frameCount * 0.01) frame intervals
metrics.rebuildMs: collect() duration only for frames whose scene-build counter increased; p50/p95/p99 are nearest-rank percentiles, not whole-frame time.

method.monitoring: Sampled about every two seconds. CPU 100% means one core-equivalent of process CPU time. Process rows below 1% may be omitted; reported means treat omitted rows as zero. Windows/GPU timestamps are local UTC+8; process timestamps are UTC. Sample windows are approximated from JSON mtime minus elapsedSeconds.

cameraTranslation.evidence: Earlier live probe verification of the same final camera-position guard

rejectedOrWithdrawn.reason: The old film helper cancelled NoGravity item tick calls; these measurements did not establish normal item-tick behavior.

rejectedOrWithdrawn.experiment: Camera visible-set precheck and adaptive variants
rejectedOrWithdrawn.reason: Edge-view tail latency regressed; no precheck/visibleItems/adaptive implementation is retained.
Fullscreen did not prove focus; PixelSky sometimes consumed over one CPU core. Formal results use only focus-gated labels.

rejectedOrWithdrawn.finding: Ordinary day/night changes make cached shadow receivers stale
rejectedOrWithdrawn.reason: In 1.21.1 ClientLevel the integer getSkyDarken() is updated only during construction; vanilla shadow rendering uses the same integer-based raw-brightness API. The guard remains compatibility protection for a mod that explicitly updates that integer.

limitations: Only one 20-second sample per variant/mode; no statistical significance or long-session stability claim.
Forced rebuild p95 improves, but fixed/rotate/edge average FPS and 1% low are lower in this pair; broad low-frame improvement is not established.
Forced samples used different GPU clocks (baseline mean 2210 MHz, candidate 2490 MHz); both were mostly CPU-bound, but residual hardware variation remains.
Frozen animation phases/game times differ across runs. Background activity and GPU power are observed, not fully controlled.
Tick freeze removes normal game update cost; these results do not establish normal-game low-frame stability or elimination of periodic frame-time spikes.
Raw CSV/JFR files remain in ignored local build directories; only quantitative summaries, scene checks and noise summaries are committed.
